core_obligations: Choose an affine scheme $U$ with a surjective etale morphism $U \to X$ and note that $U$ is a Noetherian scheme (proof lines 2349-2354).

Observe that both conditions are detected after restricting to $U$: $\mathcal{I}^n\mathcal{F}|_U = 0$ if and only if $\mathcal{I}^n\mathcal{F} = 0$, and likewise for the support condition (proof lines 2355-2357).
Conclude with the scheme case of the equivalence applied on $U$ (proof lines 2357-2358).
proof_roadmap: The Noetherian affine etale cover (proof lines 2349-2354).
Both conditions are etale local (proof lines 2355-2357).
Reduction to the scheme case (proof line 2358).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes the vanishing of a power of the ideal of a closed subspace acting on a coherent sheaf by containment of the support of the sheaf in that subspace (statement lines 2338-2346). The proof passes to an affine Noetherian scheme etale over the space, notes that both the annihilation condition and the support condition are local for that cover, and concludes by the corresponding statement for schemes. The reduction to schemes and the locality check are the substance, so the claim is H2.
